/* 구포털 기획(gihoek/index.html)의 견적서 인쇄 함수 원본 — 새 영업기획 견적서 서식이 같은 결과를 내는지 대조하는 기준(2026-10-13 본섭·테섭 동일). 수정하지 않는다. */
window.printEst=function(id){ const e=estimates.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!e) return; const p=projects.find(x=>x.id===e.pjtId);
  const sup=estSupply(e), vat=Math.round(sup*0.1), tot=sup+vat;
  const iss=e.issuer||{}, cl=e.client||{};
  const rows=e.items.map((it,i)=>`<tr><td style="text-align:center">${i+1}</td><td>${it.name||''}</td><td>${it.spec||''}</td><td style="text-align:right">${won(it.qty)}</td><td style="text-align:right">${won(it.price)}</td><td style="text-align:right">${won(itemAmt(it))}</td><td>${it.remark||''}</td></tr>`).join('');
  const w=window.open('','_blank'); if(!w){ toast('팝업이 차단되었습니다.'); return; }
  w.document.write(`<!doctype html><html lang="ko"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>견적서 ${e.no}</title>
  <style>@page{size:A4;margin:16mm}*{box-sizing:border-box;font-family:'Malgun Gothic','맑은 고딕',sans-serif}
  body{margin:0;color:#1a2330;font-size:12px}
  h1{text-align:center;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:14px;margin:0 0 18px;font-weight:800}
  .meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;color:#555;margin-bottom:10px}
  .parties{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
  .pcard{flex:1;border:1px solid #cfd8e6;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px}
  .pcard .h{font-size:10px;color:#1D5BA6;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;letter-spacing:1px}
  .pcard .nm{font-size:14px;font-weight:800}
  .pcard .ln{font-size:11px;color:#444;margin-top:2px}
  table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:6px}
  th,td{border:1px solid #cfd8e6;padding:7px 8px;font-size:11.5px}
  th{background:#eaf2fc;color:#1D5BA6;font-weight:700}
  tfoot td{font-weight:700;background:#f6f9fd}
  .tot{font-size:14px}
  .stamp{margin-top:24px;text-align:right;font-size:12px;color:#333}
  .title-row{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin:6px 0 12px;text-align:center;color:#1D5BA6}
  </style></head><body>
  <h1>견 적 서</h1>
  <div class="meta"><span>견적번호: ${e.no}${(e.rev||1)>1?' (개정 r'+e.rev+')':''}</span><span>작성일: ${e.date}</span></div>
  <div class="parties">
    <div class="pcard"><div class="h">공급받는자</div><div class="nm">${cl.company||'-'}</div>
      <div class="ln">${cl.ceo?'대표 '+cl.ceo:''}${cl.bizno?' / '+cl.bizno:''}</div>${cl.contact?`<div class="ln">${cl.contactTel?cl.contactTel+' ':''}(${cl.contact})</div>`:(cl.tel?`<div class="ln">${cl.tel}</div>`:'')}${cl.address?`<div class="ln">${cl.address}</div>`:''}</div>
    <div class="pcard"><div class="h">공급자</div><div class="nm">${iss.company||'-'}</div>
      <div class="ln">${iss.ceo?'대표 '+iss.ceo:''}${iss.bizno?' / '+iss.bizno:''}</div>${iss.tel?`<div class="ln">${iss.tel}</div>`:''}${iss.email?`<div class="ln">${iss.email}</div>`:''}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="title-row">${p?'['+p.code+'] ':''}${e.title}</div>
  <table><thead><tr><th style="width:34px">No</th><th>품명</th><th>규격</th><th style="width:60px">수량</th><th style="width:96px">단가</th><th style="width:110px">금액</th><th style="width:90px">비고</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
  <tfoot>
    <tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:right">공급가액</td><td style="text-align:right">${won(sup)}</td><td></td></tr>
    <tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:right">부가세 (10%)</td><td style="text-align:right">${won(vat)}</td><td></td></tr>
    <tr class="tot"><td colspan="5" style="text-align:right">합계금액</td><td style="text-align:right">${won(tot)}</td><td></td></tr>
  </tfoot></table>
  ${e.notes?`<div style="margin-top:14px;border:1px solid #cfd8e6;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px"><div style="font-size:10px;color:#1D5BA6;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px;letter-spacing:1px">특기사항</div><div style="font-size:11.5px;white-space:pre-wrap">${e.notes.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;')}</div></div>`:''}
  <div class="stamp">위와 같이 견적합니다.<br><br>${iss.company||''} ${iss.ceo?'　대표 '+iss.ceo+' (인)':''} ${iss.contact?'<br><span style="font-size:11px;color:#555">담당: '+iss.contact+(iss.contactTel?' &nbsp;'+iss.contactTel:'')+(iss.contactEmail?' &nbsp;'+iss.contactEmail:'')+'</span>':''}</div>
  <scr`+`ipt>window.onload=function(){setTimeout(function(){window.print();},250);}</scr`+`ipt>
  


</body></html>`);
  w.document.close();
};
